source_document: ATRI Sample Carrier Operational Costs Report, 2025

separate_2025_industry_reference.source: ATRI 2026 Analysis of the Operational Costs of Trucking release, published July 15, 2026
separate_2025_industry_reference.caution: Different year and wider industry average; not additive to the 2024 peer-group component medians above.

caveats: Freight truckload peer group, not household-goods movers.
Peer group is limited to truckload carriers with 81–200 trucks; do not treat it as a national all-carrier estimate.
The 2024 component medians are separate marginal medians and must not be summed to reconstruct a representative truck's total cost.
Equipment payment is lease or purchase cost, not pure depreciation; compare with maintenance as ATRI advises.
Auto liability insurance excludes other coverage categories and incident costs; compare premium and incident costs together.
Box-truck class, tire count, annual mileage, cargo, operating radius, and utilization differ from tractor-trailer freight operations.
Use only as an external plausibility/sensitivity comparator. Never use directly as a production coefficient.
